templates.why_chosen: A monochrome circuit-schematic pair where the same left-to-right signal chain (oscillator, PA, antenna) appears in both panels, and the entire argument is made by (b) visibly containing fewer blocks than (a).
templates.what_to_learn: When the contribution is component removal rather than a single marked difference, just draw the simplified signal chain with visibly fewer blocks in the same left-to-right order as the baseline; add the power numbers on the schematic itself, since this figure leaves the savings claim only in the caption.
